description: This Java class defines the response structure for retrieving the status of a connection in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates details such as connection ID, connection status, live status, timestamps, and resource statuses, providing methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and building instances.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a connection status retrieval request, including connection details, statuses, and timestamps.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions specific to RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse for serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse.Builder
classes.description: Builder class to facilitate construction of RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse instances with optional fields.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse with provided connection ID, JSON object, and headers.

methods.name: closedResponse
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating a closed connection with status details.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses JSON string or object to create a RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse instance.

methods.name: getConnectionStatus
methods.description: Returns the current connection status as a ConnectivityStatus enum.

methods.name: getLiveStatus
methods.description: Returns the current live connection status as a ConnectivityStatus enum.

methods.name: getConnectedSince
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp of when the connection was established.

methods.name: getClientStatus
methods.description: Returns a list of ResourceStatus objects representing client status.

methods.name: getSourceStatus
methods.description: Returns a list of ResourceStatus objects representing source status.

methods.name: getTargetStatus
methods.description: Returns a list of ResourceStatus objects representing target status.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends response payload as JSON, used during serialization.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the response.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the JSON entity for the response, updating its connection ID.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified headers.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing instances.
